projects.name: Jadeja Interior Studio
projects.problem: An interior design firm needed a professional online presence that captured the soul of their craft and converted visitors into enquiries.
projects.challenge: Translate the studio's aesthetic identity into a pixel-perfect, fully responsive website that felt as considered as their physical spaces.
projects.solution: A showcase website for Jadeja Interior Studio Pvt Ltd with a clean, elegant layout highlighting their portfolio, services, and brand story.
projects.implementation: Built with React.js, Bootstrap 5, and CSS3 — with smooth scroll interactions, responsive imagery grids, and a structured enquiry flow.
projects.results: A live production website giving the studio a credible digital footprint that matches the quality of their physical design work.

projects.name: VerdéVella Interiors
projects.problem: A luxury interior design brand needed a website that conveyed exclusivity and refinement to a high-end residential and commercial clientele.
projects.challenge: Create a premium digital experience that matched the brand's luxury positioning — with visual weight, refined typography, and zero clutter.
projects.solution: A high-end business website for VerdéVella Interiors with an editorial layout, rich imagery, and a curated service presentation.
projects.implementation: Developed using React.js and CSS3 with custom styling for luxurious feel — careful attention to whitespace, typography hierarchy, and imagery composition.
projects.results: A polished, live website that positions VerdéVella as a credible luxury brand in the competitive interior design market.

projects.name: Bloom Studio
projects.problem: A design studio needed a website that communicated their creative philosophy — 'crafting spaces that speak' — to prospective clients.
projects.challenge: Build a site that felt expressive and design-forward without sacrificing performance or mobile usability.
projects.solution: A visually engaging studio website with a bold hero, service breakdowns, and a portfolio-style layout — all reflecting Bloom Studio's creative identity.
projects.implementation: Crafted with React.js, Bootstrap 5, and CSS3 with fluid animations, responsive layouts, and clean component architecture for easy future updates.
projects.results: A live, expressive website that authentically reflects the studio's aesthetic and drives client enquiries.

projects.name: Aurora Agency
projects.problem: A creative agency needed a website that embodied their own expertise — merging strategy, art, and technology in a compelling digital experience.
projects.challenge: Build a site that could showcase diverse capabilities (branding, web design, motion, 3D, development) without fragmenting the brand identity.
projects.solution: A multi-service agency website for Aurora Agency with service tiers, case-study teasers, and a bold visual identity rooted in their tagline 'Crafting Experiences That Move the World'.
projects.implementation: Built with React.js and CSS3, structured around clear service sections, interactive elements, and a strong colour system that reflects the Aurora brand.
projects.results: A live agency website that positions Aurora as a premium creative partner and clearly communicates its full-service offering.

projects.name: NovaTech
projects.problem: A Rajkot-based IT solutions company needed a corporate website that reflected their capabilities in software, cloud, AI, and cybersecurity.
projects.challenge: Present a broad service portfolio — spanning enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, AI, and security — in a way that was clear and trustworthy, not overwhelming.
projects.solution: A structured corporate website for NovaTech with service cards, industry verticals, value propositions, and a strong call-to-action architecture.
projects.implementation: Developed with React.js, Bootstrap 5, and CSS3 — with a professional colour palette, icon-based service blocks, and responsive layouts optimised for enterprise buyers.
projects.results: A live corporate website that establishes NovaTech's credibility as a leading IT solutions provider across finance, healthcare, manufacturing, and more.

projects.name: Power Apps Business Process Automation Suite
projects.problem: Approval workflows, inventory tracking, and employee onboarding ran on manual forms and scattered spreadsheets.
projects.challenge: Automate end-to-end business processes with low-code tooling while keeping data consistent and reporting real-time.
projects.solution: A suite of Canvas and Model-Driven Power Apps automating approvals, inventory, and onboarding, with Power Automate flows triggered on form submissions.
projects.implementation: Built on Power Apps with Dataverse as the data layer, Power Automate for workflow automation, SharePoint for document management, and Power BI for consolidated KPI dashboards.
projects.results: Reduced manual form processing time by approximately 40% and delivered a single real-time management reporting view across multiple data sources.

projects.name: React.js Dynamic Web Application
projects.problem: The product needed a fast, modular frontend that rendered live data and worked consistently across every device and browser.
projects.challenge: Architect a component-based SPA that stayed maintainable while feature modules kept growing.
projects.solution: A modular React.js single-page application with dynamic data rendering via REST API integration and fully responsive layouts.
projects.implementation: Built with React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and Bootstrap 5, structured around a reusable component library with clean separation of concerns.
projects.results: Improved page load performance, achieved consistent UX across screen sizes, and reduced feature development time for subsequent modules by an estimated 25%.

projects.name: Data Analytics & Visualization Dashboard
projects.problem: Stakeholders couldn't monitor business metrics without waiting on manual, error-prone reporting cycles.
projects.challenge: Build an end-to-end pipeline from raw data ingestion to polished dashboards that non-technical users could read at a glance.
projects.solution: An analytics pipeline covering data ingestion, cleaning, analysis, and final visualization dashboards for business reporting.
projects.implementation: Combined SQL and Excel for data preparation with Power BI for interactive dashboards monitoring real-time metrics and trends.
projects.results: Enabled stakeholders to track metrics in real time, supporting faster and more informed decision-making.

philosophy.title: Understand the Business First
philosophy.description: Great software starts with listening. I work with stakeholders to understand the real process before choosing the tool — whether that's React, Laravel, or a low-code Power App.

philosophy.title: Automate the Repetitive
philosophy.description: Every manual form, copy-paste, and repeated report is an opportunity. Automating it frees people for higher-value work — and removes errors at the source.

philosophy.title: Let the Data Decide
philosophy.description: From cleaning raw datasets to building Power BI dashboards, I believe decisions should be driven by clear, trustworthy, real-time data — not guesswork.

philosophy.title: Build Reusable Foundations
philosophy.description: Reusable React components and clean architecture cut feature development time and make every subsequent module faster to ship.
